#  Fit models with introgressed lines Am^Bal, Am^Trento, Am^Par6 and Am^Rennes for Batch 6 and Batch 7

```{r}

## Load aggregated data
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

##Filter data for Batch 6 nad 7 (415 rows)
merged_data_batch67 <- merged_data |>
 dplyr::filter(Batch == 6 | Batch == 7)|>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm","Am^BalxAm^Bal", "AmxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm", "Am^TrentoxAm^Trento", "AmxAm^Trento", "Am^TrentoxAm", "Am^RennesxAm", "AmxAm^Rennes", "Am^RennesxAm^Rennes", "Am^Par6xAm^Par6", "AmxAm^Par6", "Am^Par6xAm")) #267 rows 

## Dataframe with all the strains
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("europe", 4), uninf_strain="Am" , inf_strain=c("Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6"))

# Change CI_test for introrgressed lines
merged_data_batch67 <- merged_data_batch67 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    CI_test = ifelse(grepl("^AmxBal T$|^Amx.*T$", CrossType), "Test_cross", as.character(CI_test)),
    CI_test = factor(CI_test)
  )

## Fit all models on all the crosses function with nbootsim = 500
set.seed(123)
results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZI_Beta_binomial, data=merged_data_batch67, nbootsim = 500, dec_places=3, zis = list(zi1  = ~ 1), disps = list(disp1  = ~ 1), saturated_model_estimates="m2_zi1_disp1")

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)

confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

overdisp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintdisp"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

block <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="block"))

## Add AmxAm
names(block)[names(block)=="output.parameter...1.."] <- "block"
block <- rbind(block, c("Europe", "Am", "Control", "1", "1_2_5_6_7"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS6_model_AICc.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS6_confintp1.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS6_confintp2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = overdisp, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS6_overdisp.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS6_CI_estimates.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Figure S5
```{r}

#Load the data for hatch rate per Couple (992 rows)
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))|>
  dplyr::select (-Couple_count) |>
  dplyr::select (-CrossTypeLabel)

data3 <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::filter (Batch ==6 | Batch ==7) |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm","Am^BalxAm^Bal", "AmxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm", "Am^TrentoxAm^Trento", "AmxAm^Trento", "Am^TrentoxAm", "Am^RennesxAm", "AmxAm^Rennes", "Am^RennesxAm^Rennes", "Am^Par6xAm^Par6", "AmxAm^Par6", "Am^Par6xAm")) #267 rows

#Count number of Couples only for Batch 6 and Batch7
##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- data3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data
data3 <- data3 |>
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

## create an order 
desired_order <- c(
      "AmxAm (21)",
      "AmxAm^Trento (21)","Am^TrentoxAm (21)", "Am^TrentoxAm^Trento (25)", 
      "AmxAm^Bal (20)", "Am^BalxAm (20)", "Am^BalxAm^Bal (19)",
      "AmxAm^Par6 (20)","Am^Par6xAm (19)", "Am^Par6xAm^Par6 (16)",
      "AmxAm^Rennes (21)", "Am^RennesxAm (21)","Am^RennesxAm^Rennes (23)"
   )

# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
data3 <- data3 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = factor(CrossTypeLabel, levels = desired_order)) 

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data3 <- data3 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm") ~ "'Control W-'",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm^Trento", "Am^TrentoxAm","Am^TrentoxAm^Trento") ~ "Am^Trento",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm","Am^BalxAm^Bal") ~ "Am^Bal",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm^Par6", "Am^Par6xAm","Am^Par6xAm^Par6") ~ "Am^Par6",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm^Rennes", "Am^RennesxAm","Am^RennesxAm^Rennes") ~ "Am^Rennes",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

#Create order for Pairs
pair_levels <- c("'Control W-'", "Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Par6", "Am^Rennes")

# Convert the Pair variable to a factor with the specified order
data3 <- data3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = pair_levels))

#Change name for column Cross
data3 <- data3 |>
  dplyr::rename(Cross_f = Cross)

# Add information from the zero-inflated model about median hatch rate for figure S2

datai <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS6_confintp2.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

datai <- datai |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub("^cond\\.", "", CrossType))

#Quick plot for the models results
ggplot(datai, aes(x = CrossType, y = Estimate, color = infstrain)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ infstrain, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw()

datai <- datai |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add information about hatch rate to the dataset
median_hatch_rate <- dplyr::left_join(x=datai, y=data3[, c("CoupleID", "CrossType", "CrossTypeLabel", "hatchrate","Female", "Male","Pair", "Cross_f", "Batch", "Block", "Year")], by = "CrossType")

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate_reduced |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr:: filter(!is.na(CrossTypeLabel.y))

# Plot hatch_rate
median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel.y) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel.y, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Create a Figure S5 for introgressed lines

x_label_names <- c(
  "AmxAm^Bal (20)" = bquote("Amx"~Am^Bal~" (20)"),
  "AmxAm^Trento (21)" = bquote("Amx"~Am^Trento~" (21)"),
  "AmxAm^Rennes (21)" = bquote("Amx"~Am^Rennes~" (21)"),
  "AmxAm^Par6 (20)" = bquote("Amx"~Am^Par6~" (20)"),
  "Am^BalxAm^Bal (19)" = bquote(Am^Bal~"x"~Am^Bal~" (19)"),
  "Am^TrentoxAm^Trento (25)" = bquote(Am^Trento~"x"~Am^Trento~" (25)"),
  "Am^RennesxAm^Rennes (23)" = bquote(Am^Rennes~"x"~Am^Rennes~" (23)"),
  "Am^Par6xAm^Par6 (16)" = bquote(Am^Par6~"x"~Am^Par6~" (16)"),
  "Am^BalxAm (20)" = bquote(Am^Bal~"xAm"~" (20)"),
  "Am^TrentoxAm (21)" = bquote(Am^Trento~"xAm"~" (21)"),
  "Am^RennesxAm (21)" = bquote(Am^Rennes~"xAm"~" (21)"),
  "Am^Par6xAm (19)" = bquote(Am^Par6~"xAm"~" (19)")
)

##Create plot
  hatchrateplotS5 <- median_hatch_rate_reduced |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel.y, y = Estimate, fill = Cross_f)) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = data3, aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate), position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), size =3) + 
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = x_label_names) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Estimate), y=1.1), vjust = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), size = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control cross 1 W- x W-" = "#00bfc4", "Test cross W- x W+" = "#F8766D", "Control cross 2 W+ x W-" = "#7cae00", "Control cross 3 W+ x W+" = "#c77cff")) +
  labs(x = "Cross", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Observed hatch rate and fitted hatch rate excluding structural zeros for each cross (female strain x male strain)", fill = "Cross type") +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(~Pair, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
                    labeller = ggplot2::label_parsed) +
  theme_grey(base_size = 30) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20, "pt"),
        #strip.background = element_blank(),  # Removes background from facet labels
        strip.placement = "outside", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=30, angle = 45, hjust = 1), #modify the text of the axis x
        axis.text=element_text(size=20),
        title = element_text(size = 0), #face="bold" makes it bold
        axis.title=element_text(size=35,face="bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size = 30),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size =45),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")) + # text for the subtitles/strips
        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.position = "top"
          )+ylim(0, 1.1)

#save bar plot
title_plot <- "FigS5_introgr.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   hatchrateplotS5, base_height = 40/cm(1),
                   base_width = 100/cm(1), dpi = 1200)



```

#Fit models for hatch rate in rescue experiment (Batch 1, 2)

```{r}

#Read dataset
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))|>
dplyr::filter(Batch == 1 | Batch == 2) #318 Couples

# Change CI_test for  treated lines
merged_data_batch5 <- merged_data_batch5 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    CI_test = ifelse(grepl("^AmxBal T$|^Amx.*T$", CrossType), "Test_cross", as.character(CI_test)),
    CI_test = factor(CI_test)
  )

## Dataframe with all the strains
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("europe", 12), uninf_strain=c("Am", "Am", "Am", "Am", "Mon47", "Par7", "Mon47", "Mon47","Par6","Trento", "Bal", "Bal") , inf_strain=c("Bal", "Trento", "Rennes", "Par6", "Bal", "Par6","Bal", "Rennes", "Bal", "Bal", "Trento", "Par6"))

## Fit all models on all the crosses function with nbootsim = 500

results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZI_Beta_binomial, data=merged_data, nbootsim = 500, dec_places=3, zis = list(zi1  = ~ 1), disps = list(disp1  = ~ 1), saturated_model_estimates="m2_zi1_disp1")

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)

confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

overdisp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintdisp"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

block <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="block"))

## Add AmxAm
names(block)[names(block)=="output.parameter...1.."] <- "block"
block <- rbind(block, c("Europe", "Am", "Control", "1", "1_2_5_6_7"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS3_model_AICc.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS3_confintp1.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS3_confintp2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = overdisp, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS3_overdisp.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS3_CI_estimates.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

# Female genetic effect (Figure S7, Table S8)
##Compute hatch rate with the model

```{r}

#Read dataset
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Dataframe with all the strains
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("europe", 12), uninf_strain=c("Am", "Am", "Am", "Am", "Mon47", "Par7", "Mon47", "Mon47","Par6","Trento", "Bal", "Bal") , inf_strain=c("Bal", "Trento", "Rennes", "Par6", "Bal", "Par6","Bal", "Rennes", "Bal", "Bal", "Trento", "Par6"))

## Fit all models on all the crosses function
results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZIBinomial, nbootsim=500)

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)
##crossnum <- 1:2
confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp1_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CI_estimates_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
```
## Create a Figure S4 rescue 

```{r, eval=FALSE}

#Load the data for hatch rate per Couple (1810 rows)
merged_data2 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

# Filter only necessary CrosTypes 
merged_data <- merged_data  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID =as.factor(CoupleID))

data4 <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("BalxPar6", "Par6xBal", "BalxTrento", "TrentoxBal" , "AmxBal", "AmxTrento", "AmxPar6")) ##142 rows

## create an order 
desired_order <- c(
  "AmxBal (46)", "AmxTrento (41)", "AmxPar6 (13)","TrentoxBal (10)", "BalxTrento (11)", "Par6xBal (10)", "BalxPar6 (11)")
      
# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
data4 <- data4 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = factor(CrossTypeLabel, levels = desired_order)) 

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data4 <- data4 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "AmxTrento", "AmxPar6") ~ "Control",
    CrossType %in% c("BalxTrento", "TrentoxBal") ~ "Trento/Bal",
    CrossType %in% c("BalxPar6", "Par6xBal") ~ "Par6/Bal",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

#Create order for Pairs
pair_levels <- c("Control", "Trento/Bal", "Par6/Bal")

# Convert the Pair variable to a factor with the specified order
data4 <- data4 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = pair_levels))

# Plot hatch_rate
data4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

        axis.text=element_text(size=20),

        axis.title=element_text(size=35,face="bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size = 30),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size =45),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")) + # text for the subtitles/strips
        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.position = "top"
          )

#save bar plot

##Add information from the zero-inflated model about median hatch rate for figure S6

```{r}

dataS6 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Intrastrain_Batch2_full.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

#Add information about AmxPar6 Cross
dataS3_Par <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Batch.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

dataS3_Par <- dataS3_Par |>
  dplyr::filter (type == "cond.CrossTypeAmxL6")

dataS6 <- dplyr::bind_rows(dataS6, dataS3_Par) |>
dplyr::mutate(type=factor(type))

dataS6 <- dataS6 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

#Change name of L6 to Par6
change_name <- function (data, strain_name_old, strain_name_new) {
  data <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      CrossType = stringr::str_replace_all(CrossType, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      uninfstrain = stringr::str_replace_all(uninfstrain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      infstrain = stringr::str_replace_all(infstrain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      type = stringr::str_replace_all(type, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
    )}

### To do list of strains
strain_replacements <- list(
  "L6" = "Par6",
  "L7" = "Par7",
  "MT47" = "Mon47"
  )

for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  dataS6 <- change_name(dataS6, old_strain, new_strain)
}

#Quick plot for the models results
ggplot(dataS6, aes(x = CrossType, y = Estimate, color = infstrain)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ infstrain, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw()

dataS6 <- dataS6 |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

dataS6 <- dataS6 |>
 dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "Par7xBal", "Par7xPar6", "Mon47xRennes" , "AmxBal", "AmxPar6", "AmxRennes"))

# Add information about hatch rate to the dataset
median_hatch_rate <- dplyr::left_join(x=dataS6, y=data2[, c("CoupleID", "CrossType", "CrossTypeLabel", "hatchrate","Female", "Male", "Continent", "Pair", "Cross", "Batch", "Block", "Year")], by = "CrossType")

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::mutate(Cross = dplyr::case_when(
      CrossType %in% c( "AmxBal", "AmxPar6" , "AmxRennes")~ "Reference female genotype",
      CrossType %in% c ( "Mon47xBal", "Par7xBal", "Par7xPar6", "Mon47xRennes") ~ "Alternative female genotype",
      TRUE ~ Cross
    ))

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate_reduced |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr:: filter(!is.na(CrossTypeLabel))

# Plot hatch_rate
median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

## create an order 
desired_order <- c(
        "AmxBal (46)", "Mon47xBal (18)", "Par7xBal (10)",
       "AmxPar6 (13)", "Par7xPar6 (34)",
    "AmxRennes (29)", "Mon47xRennes (19)"
   )

# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = factor(CrossTypeLabel, levels = desired_order)) 

# Plot hatch_rate
median_hatch_rate_reduced %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%

  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +

  theme_grey(base_size = 30) +
